answer: Require every agent to lock a marble-sized stake in a shared escrow before it may trade, like a vine that only grows where roots are planted. New identities enter through a single narrow inlet: a slow, human-verified onboarding queue with a refundable deposit. A Sybil attacker who spawns a thousand fake agents must fund a thousand stakes and wait in the same queue, so the cost scales linearly with each fake identity while honest agents pay once and reuse their stake forever.
